name: Featured Image from URL (FIFU)
author: fifu.app

sections.description:
Featured images from URLs, without uploading image files

Featured Image from URL (FIFU) lets you use an image hosted elsewhere as the featured image for a WordPress post, page, or supported custom post type. It also lets you set WooCommerce product images directly from image URLs.

Paste an image URL into FIFU instead of uploading the original file to your WordPress Media Library. The image is displayed from its existing location, while FIFU integrates it with WordPress featured image and post thumbnail functionality.

Why use FIFU?

  • Save storage space: Keep original image files on their existing servers instead of copying them to your WordPress hosting.
  • Simplify content imports: Assign featured images using URLs without downloading each original image.
  • Manage images easily: Preview and change featured image URLs in the editor or Quick Edit.
  • Use images with WooCommerce: Assign remote images to products and product categories.
  • Automate repetitive tasks: Set featured images from post content, WP-CLI, or developer functions.
  • Control image display: Configure alt text, default images, presentation options, and fallbacks for broken URLs.

FIFU has helped WordPress websites use remote featured images since 2015.

How to add a featured image from a URL

  1. Edit a post, page, or WooCommerce product in WordPress.
  2. Paste a direct, publicly accessible image URL into the FIFU featured image field.
  3. Preview the image and save or update the content.

The original image stays on its source server. Make sure that server permits the image to be displayed on your website.

FREE: Featured images and image settings

  • Featured image from URL: Use an external image as the featured image for posts, pages, and supported custom post types.
  • Image alt text: Set alternative text for a remote featured image without uploading the file.
  • Optimized Images: Configure FIFU’s image optimization and display options for remote images.
  • Square images: Present images in a square format using FIFU’s square image option.
  • Unsplash image search: Search Unsplash for an image and use its URL as featured media.
  • Default featured image: Display a chosen image when a post or page has no featured image.
  • Hide Featured Media: Hide featured media where FIFU controls its display.
  • Post content settings: Control how FIFU adds or displays featured media within post content.
  • Automatic image title: Set image titles automatically using FIFU’s title setting.
  • Featured image admin column: View featured image information in WordPress content lists.
  • Quick Edit: Preview, change, or remove a remote featured image without opening the full editor.
  • Disable right-click: Disable the right-click context menu on frontend images. This does not prevent visitors from downloading images.
  • Replace Not Found Image: Display a fallback when a remote image fails to load, without changing the saved image URL.

FREE: Category and taxonomy images

  • Category image from URL: Set an external image for supported WordPress categories and taxonomy terms.
  • Category image alt text: Add alternative text to supported category images.

FREE: WooCommerce product images

  • Product image from URL: Set a WooCommerce product’s main image using an external image URL.
  • Product category images: Use remote images for WooCommerce product categories.
  • Product image lightbox: Use WooCommerce’s image lightbox with compatible remote product images.
  • Product image zoom: Use WooCommerce’s image zoom with compatible remote product images.

Multiple-image product galleries, video galleries, and variation image galleries require FIFU PRO.

FREE: Automation and integrations

  • Featured image from post content: Automatically use an image found in a post’s content as its featured image.
  • WP-CLI: Manage featured images using FIFU’s command-line functionality.
  • Developer functions: Set post and category image URLs programmatically using FIFU’s public functions.
  • Elementor featured image widget: Display featured images through FIFU’s Elementor widget.
  • Gravity Forms featured image field: Add a featured image field to compatible Gravity Forms workflows.
  • Dokan featured image field: Enter a featured image URL through compatible Dokan forms.

FIFU PRO: Featured videos

Use a video URL as featured media on supported WordPress content. Featured videos are available in FIFU PRO, not FIFU Free.

  • Featured video from URL: Set an external video as the featured media for a post or page.
  • Video thumbnails: Show an image preview for featured videos.
  • Play button: Add a play button to video previews.
  • Playback controls: Configure available video player controls.
  • Autoplay: Start playback automatically when permitted by the browser.
  • Autoplay on mouseover: Play a video when the visitor moves the pointer over it.
  • Loop: Replay a video automatically when it ends.
  • Mute: Start or play a video without sound.
  • Watch Later: Enable the Watch Later option for compatible featured videos.
  • Minimum width: Set a minimum width for featured video display.

Video playback depends on the video provider, browser policies, and the theme or player used on the page.

FIFU PRO: WooCommerce galleries and product variations

  • Remote product image galleries: Add multiple externally hosted images to a WooCommerce product gallery.
  • Product video galleries: Include videos in WooCommerce product galleries.
  • FIFU product gallery: Use FIFU PRO’s own product gallery interface.
  • Variable product images: Manage remote images for WooCommerce variable products.
  • Variation images: Assign external image URLs to individual product variations.
  • Variation image galleries: Add multiple images to individual product variations.
  • Automatic product category images: Assign WooCommerce product category images automatically.
  • Quick Buy: Add FIFU PRO’s Quick Buy functionality to compatible product displays.
  • Images in order emails: Include product images in WooCommerce order emails.
  • Download to Media Library: Optionally save remote images as local WordPress media files.

FIFU PRO: WP All Import and WooCommerce imports

  • WP All Import add-on: Assign featured media from image URLs supplied in WP All Import data.
  • WooCommerce import features: Use FIFU PRO’s tools to handle remote product images during compatible imports.
  • Advanced REST API integration: Manage featured media through FIFU PRO’s REST API features.

FIFU Free already supports manually entered product image URLs, featured images from post content, WP-CLI, and the Free developer functions.

FIFU PRO: Automatic featured media

  • Search engine image search: Find images through FIFU PRO’s search engine image options.
  • Title-based image search: Use a post’s title to search for a featured image.
  • Web page URL: Find featured media using a web page address.
  • ASIN: Find product images using an Amazon Standard Identification Number.
  • Custom fields: Read image or media URLs from custom fields.
  • Website screenshots: Use a screenshot of a web page as featured media.
  • Automatic social sharing: Use FIFU PRO’s automatic social sharing options.

FIFU PRO: Galleries, sliders, and audio

  • Remote image galleries: Display several externally hosted images in a gallery.
  • Remote video galleries: Display multiple videos in a gallery.
  • Featured sliders: Use a slider as featured media instead of a single image.
  • Featured audio: Use audio as featured media on compatible content.

FIFU PRO: Additional integrations and controls

  • Elementor featured video widget: Display featured videos with FIFU’s Elementor widget.
  • Gravity Forms video field: Add a featured video field to compatible Gravity Forms workflows.
  • Gravity Forms slider field: Add a featured slider field to compatible Gravity Forms workflows.
  • Dokan product gallery field: Manage product gallery media through compatible Dokan forms.
  • bbPress and BuddyBoss Platform: Use FIFU PRO’s integrations with these community platforms.
  • Custom popups: Configure popup display for featured media.
  • Page redirection: Configure page redirects using FIFU PRO’s redirection feature.
  • Shortcodes: Insert FIFU media using the available PRO shortcodes.

Developer functions

Use these public functions to assign featured media programmatically. Functions marked [PRO] require FIFU PRO.

  • Featured image [FREE]: fifu_dev_set_image($post_id, $image_url)
  • Category image [FREE]: fifu_dev_set_category_image($term_id, $image_url)
  • Featured video [PRO]: fifu_dev_set_video($post_id, $video_url)
  • Featured slider [PRO]: fifu_dev_set_slider($post_id, $url_list, $alt_list)
  • Image list [PRO]: fifu_dev_set_image_list($post_id, $image_url_list)
  • Video list [PRO]: fifu_dev_set_video_list($post_id, $video_url_list)
  • Category video [PRO]: fifu_dev_set_category_video($term_id, $video_url)

FIFU Cloud: Optional image service

FIFU Cloud is a separate, optional service for managing and delivering images. Its features include:

  • Cloud storage: Store images in the cloud.
  • Global CDN: Deliver images through a content delivery network.
  • Optimized thumbnails: Generate optimized thumbnails through the cloud service.
  • Scheduled uploads and deletions: Schedule cloud image management tasks.
  • Hotlink protection: Use cloud hotlink protection features.

FIFU Cloud is not required to use external featured images in FIFU Free.

Try FIFU Online: Free and PRO Demos

Want to see FIFU in action? Try the Free plugin on a temporary WordPress site, explore the PRO demo, or learn about premium features and pricing.

  • FIFU Free demo: Try FIFU Free on TasteWP
  • FIFU PRO demo: Explore the FIFU PRO demo
  • FIFU PRO features and pricing: Learn more about FIFU PRO
sections.installation:
Install from the WordPress dashboard

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Featured Image from URL or FIFU.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Edit a post, page, or WooCommerce product and enter an image URL in the FIFU featured image field.

Install manually

  1. Upload the featured-image-from-url folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate FIFU from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Edit your content and set its featured image using an image URL.
sections.faq:
Can I use an external image URL as a WordPress featured image?

Yes. Paste the direct image URL into the FIFU featured image field and save your post or page. The original image stays on its source server instead of being uploaded to your Media Library.

Can I use a remote image as a WooCommerce product image?

Yes. FIFU Free lets you set the main product image and product category images from external URLs. Product image galleries, video galleries, and variation image galleries require FIFU PRO.

Is a post thumbnail the same as a featured image?

In WordPress, “post thumbnail” is the technical name used by the featured image API. FIFU integrates remote image URLs with WordPress featured image functionality.

How do I add a featured image using an image URL?

Open the WordPress editor, paste a direct image URL into the FIFU featured image field, check the preview, and save your changes.

Why isn’t the image preview working?

Check that the URL points directly to a publicly accessible image, not a web page. The image host may block requests from other websites or require authentication.

Does FIFU download images into the Media Library?

FIFU Free does not download the original image files by default. It may create WordPress attachment records and metadata to integrate remote images with WordPress features, but those records are not local copies of the images. FIFU PRO includes an option to download remote images when local files are needed.

Why isn’t my remote featured image displaying?

Check the image URL, the availability of its source server, and any hotlink protection. Also check FIFU’s Hide Featured Media setting and clear page or CDN caches if necessary.

What happens when a remote image becomes unavailable?

The image may stop displaying. FIFU Free’s Replace Not Found Image option can show a fallback image when the original URL fails. The saved image URL is not automatically repaired.

Why is the featured image displayed twice?

Your theme may display the featured image automatically while FIFU is also configured to show it in the post content. Check your theme and FIFU’s post content settings.

Can FIFU automatically set featured images from post content?

Yes. FIFU Free can select an image found in post content and assign it as the featured image. FIFU PRO adds other automatic sources, including title-based image search and custom fields.

Why don’t my settings changes appear immediately?

Your site or CDN may be showing a cached version of the page. Clear the relevant caches and reload the page to check the updated settings.

Should I clean up FIFU metadata before uninstalling?

Review FIFU’s metadata cleanup tools before removing the plugin. Only remove FIFU-related records you no longer need, and take care not to delete unrelated local media.

What metadata does FIFU create?

FIFU stores information that helps WordPress and compatible plugins work with remote images. This can include attachment records and image metadata even when the original image files remain on external servers.

What are the advantages of remote featured images?

Using image URLs can save local storage space and simplify imports, especially when the images are already hosted elsewhere.

What are the disadvantages of remote images?

Your site depends on the image host remaining available and allowing external display. Large image files, slow source servers, and hotlink restrictions can also affect how images load.

Do remote images affect WordPress SEO?

Search engines may index externally hosted images, but FIFU does not guarantee image indexing or higher rankings. Use descriptive alt text, accessible image URLs, suitable image sizes, and reliable hosting.

Can remote images make my website faster?

Not automatically. Remote images can reduce local storage use and the work needed during imports, but page loading speed depends on the image host, file size, caching, and CDN delivery.

Can I use featured videos with FIFU Free?

Featured videos, featured audio, and featured sliders require FIFU PRO. FIFU Free supports external featured images.

Does FIFU work with WP All Import?

FIFU PRO provides an add-on for assigning featured media from WP All Import data. This add-on is not included in FIFU Free.
sections.changelog:
6.1.3

  • New free feature: Replace Not Found Image to display a fallback image when a remote image fails to load.
  • Enhancement: Improved Quick Editor image preview sizing for a more compact and responsive dialog.
  • Fix: Improved remote image attachment cleanup to protect local media and images still in use.
  • Fix: Improved remote image synchronization and recovery.
  • Enhancement: Refreshed the FIFU administration interface.

6.1.2

  • New: Disable right-click on frontend images from FIFU settings.
  • Fix: Resolved PHP 8.5 and newer deprecation warnings during remote image URL validation.
  • Compatibility: Improved compatibility with PHP 8.5 and PHP 8.6.

6.1.1

  • Fix: Explicit FIFU featured image removals and replacements are no longer overwritten by later Content Egg synchronization.
  • Fix: The Status page now shows DB2-backed featured image URLs correctly even when the site is using legacy mode.
  • Enhancement: Combined the PRO Featured Video and Featured Audio settings preview into a single Video / Audio section.
  • Compatibility: Added support for WordPress 7.1.3.

6.1.0

  • Fix: Preserved query-dependent featured image URLs in Rank Math Facebook and Twitter social metadata.
  • Enhancement: Removed the outdated Troubleshooting page from the FIFU menu.

6.0.9

  • Enhancement: Unified the Featured Media editor with the new Premium-style layout and improved the Quick Editor experience.
  • Enhancement: Improved featured image preview, alternative text editing, and locked PRO media controls in the editor.
  • Enhancement: Unified the product category featured media editor.
  • Enhancement: Added WP Automatic Pro integration for FIFU remote featured images.
  • Fix: Rank Math now preserves query parameters in social image URLs.
  • Fix: Rank Math now detects FIFU alternative text correctly for featured images.
  • Fix: Eliminated repeated FIFU attachment-author database queries to improve performance.
  • Compatibility: Added support for WordPress 7.1.2 and WooCommerce 11.1.2.

6.0.8

  • Fix: Security issue reported by the Patchstack team.

6.0.7

  • Fix: Database updates can now retry after a failed update.

6.0.6

  • Enhancement: Manual metadata generation and cleanup now use a faster browser-driven workflow.
  • Fix: Improved the Clear Metadata tool with more reliable processing and progress reporting.
  • Performance: Improved compatibility with FacetWP to avoid unnecessary image processing.
  • Fix: Remote product images are now handled correctly when duplicating WooCommerce products.
  • Fix: Improved compatibility with themes and plugins that provide WordPress object IDs as numeric strings.
  • Fix: Signed CDN image URLs now work correctly with Unicode characters.
  • Fix: Improved compatibility with block-based editors by preventing conflicting WordPress editor scripts from being loaded.
  • Fix: Improved WoodMart compatibility by preventing remote FIFU images from being processed as local thumbnails.

6.0.5

  • Fix: Featured images are now synchronized correctly with third-party plugins that process posts immediately after they are saved.
  • Fix: WooCommerce product featured images no longer disappear after changing a product permalink.

6.0.4

  • Fix: Fixed featured image synchronization in the block editor (Gutenberg) when setting, changing, or removing a remote featured image.
